meta.notes: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 countries with the United States replaced by its states (Census cartographic boundary 1:20m, 2024). Miller projection, 360° of longitude = 4000 units (the map wraps), Antarctica left out, holes dropped. Countries are tagged with the content country they belong to (EU members → country.eu); states carry House and Senate seats by party from legislators-current.csv (independents counted with the Democratic caucus). label_x/label_y/label_r: where a region's name goes and the radius that fits there. Generated by tools/pipeline/map/map2d.py.
